## Understand the price you can act on

The hourly consumer-price estimate represents a private customer in Radius'
grid area with an Andel Energi FlexEnergi agreement. It includes VAT and variable
charges; fixed subscriptions are separate.
:::

```{r}
#| results: asis
site_metadata(snapshot, "DK2")
```

## Wholesale and consumer prices

The **wholesale spot price** is the market price for DK1 or DK2 in DKK/kWh,
before VAT and retail charges. Quarter-hour charts, historical profiles,
period averages and cheapest-window recommendations all use this basis.

The **consumer scenario** adds the configured VAT, supplier add-on, Radius
time-dependent network tariff, Energinet variable tariffs and electricity tax
to the hourly price. These calculations are performed once in the shared
analysis; pages display the resulting snapshot columns.

| Component | How to read it |
|:--|:--|
| Wholesale spot | Changes with the bidding zone and delivery interval; can be negative |
| VAT | Applied according to the configured scenario |
| Andel FlexEnergi add-on | Variable supplier charge from the scenario |
| Radius network tariff | Depends on local hour and season |
| Energinet tariffs | Variable system and network charges |
| Electricity tax | Scenario tax rate; special arrangements may differ |
| Fixed subscriptions | Excluded from the marginal hourly kWh price |

## Values carried by this snapshot

The following table shows the first available DK2 hour on the snapshot date.
Component columns retain the units used by the shared tariff module: variable
charges are in øre/kWh, while wholesale and total prices are in DKK/kWh.

```{r}
#| results: asis
prices <- snapshot$summaries$DK2$today
columns <- c(HourUTC = "Hour (Copenhagen)", SpotPriceDKK = "Wholesale spot (DKK/kWh)",
             RadiusNettarifInclMoms = "Radius incl. VAT (øre/kWh)",
             AndelPristillaeg = "Andel add-on (øre/kWh)",
             EnerginetTarif = "Energinet before VAT (øre/kWh)",
             elafgift = "Electricity tax before VAT (øre/kWh)",
             SpotPriceDKK_Total = "Consumer scenario incl. VAT (DKK/kWh)")
available <- intersect(names(columns), names(prices))
sample <- utils::head(prices[, available, drop = FALSE], 1)
names(sample) <- unname(columns[available])
site_table(sample, "DK2 · one hourly example from the prepared snapshot")
```

## Scope and sources

This scenario is specific to Radius / Andel and is not a universal Danish or
DK1 consumer price. Supplier contracts, fixed fees, own generation, exemptions
and installation-specific charges can alter an actual bill. Rates can change;
the scenario metadata above records what the snapshot used.

The repository's [detailed price-component documentation](https://github.com/ckrusemd/danish-electricity-prices/blob/master/PRICE_COMPONENTS.md)
provides tariff source links and subscription context. Market and weather
providers and coverage are recorded in the snapshot rather than inferred by the pages.
